result.reason: The clause reaches most of the preferred position: Company may assign without consent to an Affiliate or M&A successor, Contractor remains subject to consent not unreasonably withheld, and there is no termination right on Company change of control. However, it omits the required prohibition on Contractor assigning to a Company competitor. It also does not reach the fallback because successor assignment rights are not mutual. The added language is otherwise targeted and professionally drafted.
